title.zh: 【Uranium Finance 黑客被判有罪，面临最高 20 年监禁】
title.en: 【Uranium Finance 黑客被判有罪，面临最高 20 年监禁】

current_state.zh: A New York jury found security consultant Jonathan Spalletta guilty of the 2021 Uranium Finance attacks that drained roughly $55 million, exposing him to up to 20 years in prison on Tornado Cash-linked money-laundering charges, with sentencing scheduled for February 16 and authorities having seized over $31 million in crypto plus rare collectibles and artifacts.
